title: Sable and the Aftermath
author: Bram Dravenmoor
blurb: Freya Villalobos, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, has spent seven years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
